about: GENERATED by scripts/build-npc-0105.mjs on the applied 0001-0102 chain. Do not edit: re-run the build. docs/NPC_FLEET_SCALE.md slice C; owner rows 116, 118, 119, 122a. MEASURED means sailed through the one executor (npc_found → npc_traders_switch → voyage.settle at every arrival, npc_plan + npc_tend on the hour, tick_market_drift per slot, hazards off): that is the 40-route SAMPLE in `sample` only. DERIVED means the server's own planner answered on the untouched market (public.npc_plan once per route, its lines priced through world.quote): that is every route's capital. What this build does NOT have, and 0098 did: a per-fleet measurement with the whole roster sailing for many laps. That interaction was always the deploy's soak (docs/NPC_TRADERS.md §5.1) and it is said here rather than quietly dropped.
share_formula: fleets(nation) = round(760 × Σ(ports.dev_commerce + ports.dev_industry) over that nation's HARBOURS ÷ Σ over all nations)

crew.note: 0097 cmd.do_hire draws only the hands ABOVE npc_crew_pool_floor off a quay for a merchant and recruits the rest at crew_urgent_multiplier without touching the pool, and leaves crew_pool itself alone either way. So a quay is a PRICE to a merchant, not a budget a roster can overdraw. The per-STOP capacity rule (crew_pool >= floor + a fifth of the fleet) is what the migration asserts.
